method: fresh on-policy exact-mean-KL natural-gradient trust-region actor/value (finite TRPO variant)
structural_difference: One full-batch actor gradient, KL Hessian-vector Fisher solve with conjugate gradient, and bounded backtracking on exact analytic latent Gaussian mean KL. No clipped PPO ratio/actor Adam, action-score paired companion estimator, Q/TD/replay/target/entropy/temperature/distributional action codebook or whole-policy perturbation proposal. No old model/optimizer/RNG/data learning reuse.

policy.inputs: tanh(current actual native50), tanh(causal initial native50), min(control/528,1)
policy.action: reference + .18*tanh(mean+sigma*iidnormal10) REPLACES ten old leg corrections at controls1..528; old control0/head/home529+ preserved

learning.full_batch_active_controls: 1..528 only; actual invalid early terminal retained
learning.returns: Original complete episode MC returns; original home tail included, no cross-reset bootstrap, no changed rewards or labels
learning.advantage: complete_return - pre-update current value; center/scale over active samples only; stop-gradient
learning.acceptance: finite exact analytic mean KL<=.001 and actual surrogate gain >= .1*positive predicted gain; first passing backtrack only; otherwise actor unchanged

gates.eligible: standard/allvalid/preserve every baseline success/strictly >18; common checkpoint selection success,min original return,sum original return,earlier checkpoint; else R157 fallback
gates.qualification: UNREAD320 two nonoverlap20 each>=18/20 then all larger perturbation/delay/right/prone/supine gates

theory.use: Fisher/CG/mean-KL/backtracking structure only. Finite sampled variant is not the theoretical maximum-state-KL guarantee and not monotonic improvement or robot safety proof.
